name: io.github.Tifdt/port402-memory
title: Port 402 Memory
description: Persistent memory for AI agents, paid per call in USDC on Base (x402). No account, no API key.

environmentVariables.name: PORT402_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated Base wallet holding a few USDC. It pays each call and is your private memory namespace.

environmentVariables.name: PORT402_MAX_USD_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Spending cap per call in USD (default 0.01).
